LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingFactionAdvice: Other factions' doctors and mechanics give advice by radio
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingFactionAdviceDesc: When none of your colonists can help, a doctor or mechanic at another faction's settlement in radio reach can talk your colonist through tending, an operation or a vehicle repair. Allies help free, once a day; a neutral faction asks a little goodwill for each call, and never more than leaves its goodwill at zero. Hostile factions never help. On by default.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioAdvice_ReasonFaction: Talked through by radio by {ADVISER} of {FACTION} ({SKILL} {LEVEL})
LanguageData.PhobosRadioAdvice_ReasonFactionAid: Talked through by radio by {ADVISER} of {FACTION} ({SKILL} {LEVEL}), with a {AID} at hand
LanguageData.PhobosRadioAdvice_FactionCallAlly: {HELPER}, {ROLE} of {FACTION}, is on the radio for {CARER}, as a favour between allies.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioAdvice_FactionCallNeutral: {HELPER}, {ROLE} of {FACTION}, is on the radio for {CARER}. {FACTION} asks {GOODWILL} goodwill for the call.
